fields.title: Welcome to Anvesh
fields.body: Anvesh is a lightweight search stack for Node.js by VaagaTech. Run full-text search locally without operating a heavy cluster.

fields.title: BM25 keyword search
fields.body: The engine ranks documents with BM25 for keyword queries. Highlight snippets make it easy to show why a hit matched.

fields.title: Semantic and hybrid modes
fields.body: Combine keyword BM25 with vector similarity for hybrid search. Semantic mode is useful when exact terms do not appear in the document.

fields.title: Geo search near Bengaluru
fields.body: Index geo_point fields and filter by radius or bounding box. Sort results by distance for location-aware demos.

fields.title: Hub control plane
fields.body: Anvesh Hub is an optional RBAC control plane. Register multiple engine, spider, and indexer instances and manage indexes from one UI.

fields.title: RBAC roles in Hub
fields.body: Hub supports admin, operator, and viewer roles. Admins manage users and instances; operators run indexes and jobs; viewers can search.

fields.title: Site spider with roles
fields.body: The spider crawls a site with BFS, robots.txt, and sitemaps. Role-based login discovers pages for guest, form, cookie, or bearer sessions.

fields.title: Bulk indexer
fields.body: Load JSON or JSONL into an index with the indexer CLI or worker. Map crawled pages into documents and push them to the engine API.

fields.title: Filesystem storage by default
fields.body: Local development uses Node.js and filesystem storage. No Docker is required for day-to-day work. Data lives under .anvesh/data.

fields.title: Pluggable storage backends
fields.body: Production can use Redis, S3, DynamoDB, or MongoDB for index state. Swap storage with environment variables without changing application code.

fields.title: Easy setup installer
fields.body: anvesh-setup scaffolds .anvesh folders, writes .env.anvesh with a generated admin password, and prints how to start each app.

fields.title: Meaningful API messages
fields.body: Responses include human-readable message fields inspired by Vaakly. Operators can understand success and failure without decoding opaque codes alone.

fields.title: Open source by VaagaTech
fields.body: Anvesh is MIT licensed open source from VaagaTech. Use it for product search, docs search, or internal knowledge bases.

fields.title: Containers when you need them
fields.body: The same engine process runs in Docker, ECS, or Kubernetes. Compose is optional; prefer npm start for local demos.

fields.title: Lambda and serverless path
fields.body: SAM template support lets you expose the engine behind API Gateway with S3-backed storage for serverless demos.

fields.title: Facets and filters
fields.body: Filter by keyword fields and request facets to power category chips. Pair filters with a free-text query for catalog-style search.

fields.title: Highlight matched terms
fields.body: Turn on highlight in the search request to wrap matched tokens. Perfect for live demos where the audience should see why a result ranked.

fields.title: Multi-instance engines
fields.body: Run several engine instances on different ports or hosts. Register each URL in Hub and switch which index cluster you manage.

fields.title: Shared crawl contracts
fields.body: anvesh-shared defines crawled page shapes so spider output feeds the indexer cleanly without ad-hoc mapping scripts.

fields.title: Try the demo index
fields.body: This corpus powers the Anvesh demo. Search for lightweight, hub, geo, or spider to see keyword ranking and highlights in action.
